calculationMethod.formula: max(0, crossingDistance - entryDistance) / max(1, arrival + clearDistance / otherSpeed + 1)
calculationMethod.courseProxy: Use own recorded heading; the selected avoidance course is absent.
calculationMethod.velocityProxy: Use other recorded speed times sin/cos of recorded heading; actual velocityX/velocityY are absent.
calculationMethod.trig: Python math.sin/cos, not product detSin/detCos; derived numbers are full Python float output, not a bit-exact runtime replay.
calculationMethod.dimensions: Infer scale from initial recorded hull versus generated raw hull, then apply raw length and beam.
calculationMethod.eligibilityScope: Evaluate observable/proxy numeric guards and recorded move order type. Unrecorded order detail, rigging, and avoidance activation are not proved.
calculationMethod.precision: Recorded numbers are copied without rounding; derived numbers retain Python JSON float precision. Precision does not remove proxy uncertainty.
